rules.swallowedFailure: Flag empty catch only when adjacent to adapter/service persistence or protected-action mutation.
rules.mediaUrl: Mentor/profile photo delivery is not a protected LP4 learning-media defect. Premium Notes/Video/attachment/replay delivery is checked separately.
rules.localStorage: Presence is not itself RED; RED occurs only when local state can override newer server truth, grant protected access, or claim durable success.
rules.moduleBlocker: A 4.1-4.7 implementation requirement is carry-forward during 4.0 protocol sealing, not a fake Phase 4.0 RED.
rules.hardStop: Only repository/source/project/secret/rollback safety boundaries abort a diagnostic harvest.
